mutations.before:
const draws = (layers: readonly CreativeTemplateLayer[]) =>
    layers.filter((layer) => layer.enabled !== false);
mutations.because: MP-D3: occlusion is evaluated over the enabled subset, because a disabled layer draws nothing and so occludes nothing. Computing it over the whole array leaves a notice standing for a layer that no longer paints (and silently swallows the notice when it is switched back on, since the pair never left the list). CC3 moved the surface: the stack is now `LayerStack` in the creative rail, so the command names `layer-stack.test.tsx` -- the same MP-D3 tests, at their new address.
